tookHint: how long this generation took on your machine
seedHint: the starting number for this render — the same seed and prompt make it again
downloadHint: saves the generated file to your computer
copyHint: puts the script on your clipboard as Markdown
regenerateHint: runs the same recipe again — what's here now is kept as a take
rerollHint: runs again with a fresh seed, for a different look from the same prompt
turnIntoVideoHint: starts a full project from this script — storyboard, clips, narration
enhancePlaceholder: What should change? e.g. punchier hook, fewer scenes, end on a question
takeSwapHint: swaps back to this render — its file is still here, so nothing re-renders
takeRerenderHint: this take's file is gone — picking it renders the seed again
loopSeamAria: Play the end and the start back to back
loopSeamHint: beds loop in a video — this is the joint you'd hear
addToProjectAria: Add this output to a project
addToProjectHint: lands in the project as an asset, ready to wire in the canvas
addToProjectEmpty: No projects yet — turn an idea into one first.
cloneVoiceTipHint: re-renders in a voice from your own sample — needs the speaker's permission
cloneVoiceHint: re-renders this narration with the cloned speaker
cloneConsent: I have this speaker's permission to clone their voice
cloneUploadAria: Upload a voice sample to clone
